summary: Iteration 10: Verified SIS Secondary Sales seed-self-heal, defaults (partner + till_date=Yes), reload background job, and frontend banner/rows/hero. Backend: 7/8 new tests pass + full regression (test_sis_report.py) 20/21 pass (only pre-existing Ask/Help count mismatch fails). Frontend: /sis-sales loads with default URL params, 8 partner rows render, hero NSV-26 shows ₹13.21 Cr, till_date toggle active, banner NOT shown (data already loaded). Slicer panels open (partner 8, month Jan-Apr, week 1-16) and drill/reset work. CENTRO click on partner slicer did not visibly reduce table to 1 row in the test run — needs main-agent verification of checkbox click handler.

minor.issue: Returns weeks [14,15,16,17] but review request expected only weeks 14-16. Week 17 sneaks into 'latest_month=1' scope even though meta.latest_week=16.
Pre-existing (iterations <10): sis section has 15 non-alias help items, test expects 20. Not related to this iteration but still failing.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking CENTRO label in sis-filter-partner-panel did not filter the table down to 1 row (still 8 rows, hero unchanged). May be a checkbox event issue or panel selection race — needs manual verification.

Week panel shows only weeks 1-16 (not 1-52) and Month panel shows Jan-Apr (not Jan-Dec). Backend /api/sis/filters returns 52 weeks & 12 months; UI likely calls filters with till_date=Yes and thus displays only in-scope values. Review request expected 1..52 and Jan..Dec in the slicer.
Actual partners = [CENTRO, KORA, LIFESTYLE, LULU, R. CENTRAL, R. TRENDS, SHOPPERS, SPENCER]; review request expected 'INC5' instead of 'SPENCER'. Likely just spec drift vs. current PBIX data.

Hero shows -60.9% (red). Review request expected 'positive/green'. Actual math (NSV-26 ₹13.21 Cr vs NSV-25 ₹33.74 Cr) yields -60.9%, so likely spec expectation mismatch — flagging for main-agent review.

action_items: Investigate why selecting CENTRO in sis-filter-partner-panel did not reduce table rows in automated test (verify checkbox click event & URL update).

Decide whether Week/Month slicer panels should display full 1-52 / Jan-Dec (per spec) or only in-scope values (current). If per spec, call /api/sis/filters without till_date restriction for the panel population.
latest_month=1 scope leaks week 17 — verify server-side bmonth→week mapping for Apr.
Pre-existing: /api/ask/help sis section only has 15 non-alias items; add remaining 5 to satisfy test.
critical_code_review_comments: Reload endpoint correctly runs as background task and returns <5s.
Meta self-heal works: after seed the collection has 218447 rows and status='ready'.
Frontend default URL params (group_by=partner&till_date=Yes) correctly applied on empty query string.
Data status banner is correctly hidden when data is already ready (banner not in DOM).

success_rate.frontend: 80% (defaults/rows/hero/drill/reset OK, CENTRO filter interaction & slicer value counts diverge from spec)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded PBIX data (218447 rows already ready).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend seed self-heal + reload background flow verified end-to-end. /api/sis/meta returns status=ready with 218447 rows on this env. Focus next iteration on: (1) partner-slicer CENTRO checkbox click updating URL + table, (2) confirming whether Week/Month slicer intentionally scope-limits or should show full 1-52 / Jan-Dec, (3) week-17 leak in latest_month=1. Existing pytest files: /app/backend/tests/test_sis_report.py and /app/backend/tests/test_sis_iter10.py.
rca of the issue: Original user bug (empty sis_sales collection → all zeros, empty slicers) is FIXED — meta reports rows=218447 status=ready and page renders 8 partner rows with real ₹ values. Remaining findings are spec-vs-implementation deltas not the original bug.
